package: K27 complete export-category matrix through local HTTP

runtime.auth: real Better Auth session cookie signed with test-only secret

observed: Anonymous request returned 401; an active owner session returned 200, no-store and an attachment response; revoked session returned 401.
The response asserted all schemaVersion 4 export fields for a synthetic owner with an owned channel and EDITOR membership in another channel.

The fixture covered account, comments/reactions, subscriptions, e-mail preferences and delivery/event metadata, payments, viewing/playback history, creator profiles/memberships, notifications, patron grants/pass and media attachments.
Another account owned the collaborator channel and foreign test data; foreign comment, payment and e-mail preference data were excluded from the owner response.
Secret markers for provider IDs, event payload, payment metadata, network hashes, playback/session IDs, private notification copy/params, patron reasons and payment references were absent.
Repeated authorized export returned identical data after normalizing the per-response exportedAt timestamp.
scope_limits: Next ran in development mode; production build, reverse proxy, Redis and deployed runtime were not part of this test.
Only the seeded account and representative active categories are covered; this does not establish legal completeness or classify every row in CYKL-DANYCH.csv.
K05/K11/K26 policy dependencies, K37 large-export resource limits and independent review remain open.
status: K27-T1/T2 expanded local HTTP coverage; package remains partial.
